articles.summary: Garanti BBVA has successfully completed the sale of its Romanian subsidiary to Raiffeisen Bank – the Romanian unit of the Austrian bank, Raiffeisen Bank International AG (RBI) – for €571 million, after receiving the necessary regulatory approvals.
articles.title: Garanti BBVA Completes the Sale of Its Romanian Subsidiary

articles.summary: BBVA has tapped the market today with a senior preferred debt issuance in Swiss francs. The green bond consists of two tranches: one maturing in four years (2030) and the other in seven years (2033). Initial price guidance for the four-year tranche is SARON Midswap + 75-80 basis points, while the seven-year tranche is priced at SARON Midswap + 90-95 basis points. UBS and Commerzbank are acting as bookrunners.
articles.title: BBVA places CHF 390 million in a two-tranche senior preferred green bond issuance

articles.summary: Garanti BBVA has decided to launch a share buyback program for a maximum period of three years, reflecting its confidence in its strong financial position and long-term value creation potential.
articles.title: Garanti BBVA Announces Share Buyback Program

articles.summary: BBVA returned to the market on Wednesday with a three-tranche senior non-preferred bond issue in US dollars. The first tranche has a three-year maturity (2029) and an initial price guidance of IPT + 125 basis points. The second tranche, also maturing in 2029, carries a floating interest rate linked to the SOFR benchmark. The third tranche, with a 10-year maturity, has an initial price guidance of IPT + 160 basis points. The joint bookrunners are BBVA, Crédit Agricole CIB, HSBC, JP Morgan, Mizuho and UBS.
articles.title: BBVA places $2.05 billion in a three-tranche senior non-preferred bond with demand five times the amount issued
